_comment: Findings reviewed and accepted, so CI does not block on them. They REMAIN
visible in the Security tab — this file only stops the build gate firing.
A match needs BOTH the rule id and the exact path: the same rule appearing
in any other file still fails the build.

accepted.reason: Reviewed one by one when CodeQL was first enabled here. Two of the four hits were FIXED rather than accepted (/api/chimes and /api/chime-config had genuinely missed the limiter their sibling read endpoints use). The remaining hits are false positives: /api/broadcast/config and /api/alert-settings DO carry `preHandler: <name>ReadRateLimit`, but the query does not recognise Fastify's preHandler as a rate-limit guard. Path-scoped, so a NEW unprotected route in any other file still fails the build.

The WebSocket upgrade is guarded by a concurrency cap (admit-then-close-1013 beyond the limit) rather than a per-request rate limiter — the appropriate control for a long-lived socket, which a request-rate limiter does not model.
